verdict.label: Partner-only or paid / gated
verdict.summary: Building and testing is self-serve, but development mode caps you at 5 allowlisted users, and production (extended quota) is only for registered organizations with 250k+ monthly active users. For most agent builders, Spotify is effectively partner-only.
verdict.cost: Free API; app owner needs Spotify Premium

composioFit.summary: Composio does not provide a managed Spotify OAuth app, so you must bring your own custom Spotify OAuth app configuration.
whyOwnApp: Spotify requires custom OAuth apps because no Composio-managed app is available.
You need your own Client ID and Client Secret to authenticate requests.

phases.name: Register Spotify App
steps: Go to the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Click on the Create an App button.
Fill in app details, agree to Developer Terms, and click CREATE.
phases.handoff: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from your app overview page.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps: Navigate to your app settings in the Spotify Dashboard.
Add the Composio redirect URI to the Redirect URIs allowlist.
Configure required scopes for your integration.
phases.handoff: Save your redirect URIs and configure the auth config in the Composio dashboard.

phases.name: Test with Development Mode
steps: Add up to 5 users via the Users Management tab in the Spotify Dashboard.
Test authentication and API requests under development mode limits.
phases.handoff: Verify tokens are successfully issued and refresh tokens function correctly.

phases.name: Submit Quota Extension Request
steps: Ensure your business meets the minimum requirements (Established Business Entity and at least 250k MAUs).
Navigate to the Quota extension Request tab and submit your application.
phases.handoff: Wait for Spotify's app review team to review and approve extended quota access.

artefacts.title: Spotify Scope Justification
artefacts.body: We request user-read-private, user-read-email, playlist-read-private, and playlist-modify-private to allow our AI agent users to read their profile details and manage their playlists through conversational commands.

redirectRules.rule: Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address where HTTP is permitted.
If using a loopback address, use explicit IPv4 or IPv6 (http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://[::1]:PORT). localhost is not allowed.
The definition of the redirect URI must exactly match the redirect URI you provide when you create your app.
Use HTTPS, or an explicit loopback IP (http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://[::1]:PORT). The hostname localhost is rejected.

blockers.symptom: A 6th user (or anyone not allowlisted) gets 403 errors after connecting
blockers.cause: The app is in development mode: max 5 users, each on the allowlist.
blockers.fix: Add the user to the allowlist in the Developer Dashboard (if you have fewer than 5).
blockers.fallback: Apply for extended quota as an organization meeting the criteria; otherwise scope your product to single-user / personal use.

blockers.symptom: Dashboard rejects http://localhost:3000/callback as a redirect URI
blockers.cause: Spotify no longer allows the localhost hostname.
blockers.fix: Use http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback for local testing, and Composio's HTTPS callback for real connections.

blockers.cause: The app is in development mode and has exceeded its quota bucket limit.
blockers.fix: Request an extension or reduce API request frequency.
blockers.fallback: Upgrade to extended quota mode if eligible.

blockers.cause: The provided Client ID does not exist or is incorrect.
blockers.fix: Check your Client ID in the Spotify Developer Dashboard and update your configuration.

blockers.symptom: Unauthorized access or failure for users beyond allowlist
blockers.cause: Development mode apps are limited to up to 5 authenticated users.
blockers.fix: Add the user via the Users Management tab in the Spotify Dashboard.
blockers.fallback: Move app to extended quota mode.

checklist.text: Create a Spotify developer account and register a new app in the dashboard.
Copy Client ID and Client Secret securely.
Configure the redirect URI in the Spotify Dashboard matching your Composio auth config.
Add test users to the Users Management tab for development mode testing.
Enter Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard auth config.
Submit a Quota Extension Request if scaling beyond development mode limits.
